svg.title: Vector clocks between three nodes
svg.desc: Time proceeds downward. Vector components are ordered A, B, C. All clocks start at (0,0,0). At each local or send event, only the local component increases. A has a local event at (1,0,0), then sends m1 at (2,0,0). B has a local event at (0,1,0), receives m1, takes the componentwise maximum and increments its own component to (2,2,0), then delivers m1 to the application. B later sends m2 at (2,3,0). C has a local event at (0,0,1), then receives m2, merges and increments to (2,3,2), then delivers m2. A also has a local event at (3,0,0), concurrent with C receiving m2. Typesetting and arrowheads match the supplied Lamport-clock SVG.
